title: How to give Claude Code database access #claude #supabase #programming #claudecode #ai #claude
description:
Learn how to connect AI tools to Supabase using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for seamless data integration. This tutorial walks you through remote MCP installation and setting up secure authentication for your web applications. Perfect for developers building AI-powered backends who need reliable database connectivity. Follow these steps to grant Cloud Code authorization and secure your database interactions today.
